purpose: Fixed-version public API ledger and development-only oracle fixtures. Every non-excluded row remains a support target, including rows without a counterpart.

enumeration.numpy: Use module_structure.rst public namespace lists, declared exports, owned public definitions, reference directives, public class members and ufunc methods. Keep legacy namespaces. Private core namespaces and C API reference pages are outside the Python public-entry inventory; the Python extension exclusion does not waive numerical APIs.
enumeration.pandas: Use reference/index.rst public subpackages. Include documented io, tseries and util entries, public top-level exports, class members and accessors. Private core and compat names are not public entry points. __all__ alone is not the public boundary.
enumeration.polars: Use reference/index.rst families, public exports, owned public definitions, generated class members, property return annotations for namespaces, selectors, datatypes, schema, catalog, SQL, plugins, options and testing. Returning a container from an ordinary property does not create a nested accessor namespace.

reconciliation.reason: routines.dtypes.rst uses automodule:: numpy.dtypes; resolve autosummary names in that module.
arrays.classes.rst and arrays.interface.rst use generic class/object placeholders to describe ndarray protocols, not exported names called class or object.
Documented aliases depend on long-double storage width. Absence from the current host is not an exclusion.

rowFields.aliasOf: Object identity among pinned upstream exports, or an explicitly documented conditional dtype alias. Aliases retain separate rows. Equal constants are not inferred to be aliases.
rowFields.counterpart: Existing partial NMath entry point. A name alone does not claim argument, dtype or semantic compatibility.
rowFields.semantics: Pinned source reference. pending-review means the per-entry semantic translation remains unverified.
rowFields.arguments: Runtime signature when introspection provides it; otherwise null. pending-adaptation retains all in-scope original forms as targets.
rowFields.dtypePlatform: Per-entry conditions remain pending unless explicitly sourced. The inventory host does not establish eight-platform support.
rowFields.viewCopyMutation: Per-entry conditions remain pending. Fixtures cover only their explicit selections and mutations.
rowFields.missingValues: Per-entry conditions remain pending. No default null/NaN equivalence is assumed across libraries.
rowFields.verification: Fixture IDs identify runnable inputs, not a passing native result. Empty IDs and null criteria mean pending verification. GPU criteria remain separate and pending. Evidence paths and SHA-256 hashes identify implementation, test and fixture inputs; sourceRevision pins the inspected implementation. Evidence availability does not assert that tests ran or passed. crossPlatformStatus and gpuStatus remain pending; execution results belong in external validation records.
rowFields.supportedScope: Present only for explicitly inspected partial counterparts. Records family, supported argument/dtype conditions, limits and repository evidence paths at counterpartSourceRevision. It does not propagate through upstream aliases, certify scalar dtype classes or waive any non-excluded forms.

exclusionPolicy: Only named agreed exclusions are applied. Mixed-mode APIs remain targets until argument-specific conditions are reviewed. Plotting, styles, configuration, testing, plugins and additional local file formats are not blanket exclusions.
limitations: Enumeration is source-reconciled; semantic review and compatibility acceptance are incomplete.
Runtime introspection is from one pinned Python environment and host. Platform-dependent members require source review and platform acceptance.
Source hashes pin inspected definitions and reference inputs. They do not certify behavior.
No Python dependency is added to package exports, package installation or the production runtime.
